urgent: The customer faces serious, possibly time-sensitive harm. Open by acknowledging the seriousness, state clearly that the case has been prioritised, and give a concrete next contact within 24 hours. Calm and direct; no filler apologies.
empathetic: The customer is upset. Acknowledge their frustration sincerely once, without over-apologising, then move quickly to what will be done.
professional: The customer is calm or factual. Be courteous, concise and clear. Skip emotional language.
